overview: The Emperor’s Chamber is the seat of Shissar imperial power.
details: Here, Emperor Ssraeshza rules with divine tyranny. Elite serpent guards enforce his will, cursed constructs stand vigil, and venom wards protect the throne. The chamber pulses with ancient Shissar magic.
hooks: Imperial guards mobilize for a purge.
A cursed construct awakens from stasis.
Venom wards flare as intruders approach.
